notes.title: New Feature!!
notes.notes:
Wouldn't it be convenient if you could place your company's logo, your own icon, or your name during meetings or interviews as your business card?
In today's web conferences and interviews, it has become more difficult for people to remember your name and face, as opposed to meeting you in person.
With this new feature, you can place the image you want anywhere you want.

In the next update, you will also be able to input text.
I urge you to try out the new features while you still can!
